subject.title: fix(agents): run embedded gateway fallback on a fresh session after abnormal close

question: Should the maintainer accept the new closed-transport fallback contract that intentionally runs the CLI retry outside the accepted explicit session?
rationale: The protected label and session-state behavior require confirmation that preserving the original session exclusively for gateway recovery is the intended user-facing recovery model.

options.title: Accept isolated fallback
options.body: Confirm that abnormal-close fallback must always use a new session, then request real crash/restart proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve original-session fallback
options.body: If a fallback must continue the accepted session, define a single-owner recovery protocol instead of allowing concurrent gateway and embedded execution.

recommendation.title: Accept isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Confirm that abnormal-close fallback must always use a new session, then request real crash/restart proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author and assignee is the only concrete routing signal supplied for this recovery behavior.
